_comment: Lab WAF ruleset for Ryder's Puppy Fort Factory (config prefilter).
DELIBERATELY NAIVE, signature-based rules — a realistic-but-bypassable filter
so the Phase 8 mutation engine has a real target to learn to evade (FR-MUT-3).
These are NOT a real WAF and provide no real protection. Lab-only.
Each rule: id, category, action (block|sanitize|log; '' = use the global mode),
and a PCRE pattern (as used by PHP preg_match, delimiters included).

rules.note: bypass e.g. terminate without a trailing comment
bypass e.g. onfocus=, 'onerror =' with a space, backtick/newline splits
